cohort: The study included 5817 patients undergoing single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer after a previous live birth, categorized by whether their previous delivery was cesarean or vaginal.
finding: A previous cesarean delivery is associated with significantly lower rates of biochemical pregnancy, clinical pregnancy, and live births in patients undergoing subsequent single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer.
mod_finding: A previous cesarean delivery significantly increases the rates of repeat cesarean delivery in subsequent IVF pregnancies.
